note: Development scenarios, visible during design. Not an independent heldout set.

scenarios.what: Asks about customer needs, avoids false claims and aggressive selling.

turns.en: I am looking for a laptop. What do you recommend?

turns.es: La quiero para estudiar, sin gastar mucho.
turns.en: I want it for school, not too expensive.

turns.es: ¿Hay garantía? No veo ninguna política publicada.
turns.en: Is there a warranty? I do not see any published policy.

scenarios.what: Handles complaint naturally without inventing refunds.

turns.es: El pedido llegó tarde y estoy molesto.
turns.en: The order arrived late and I am upset.

turns.es: No tengo el número del pedido ahora mismo.
turns.en: I don't have my order number right now.
What information do you need to help me?
